title: Meena Textiles v. CIT Rajasthan
text: The assessee, Meena Textiles, challenges the penalty imposed by the Commissioner of Income Tax under Section 271(1)(c) of the Income Tax Act for alleged concealment of income in the assessment year under Section 143(3). The Assessing Officer made additions to income by disallowing certain expenses. The Commissioner of Income Tax imposed penalty on the ground that the disallowance of expenses indicates concealment. The Income Tax Appellate Tribunal deleted the penalty. The High Court affirms. Mere disallowance of expenses does not by itself amount to concealment of income warranting penalty under Section 271(1)(c). The deduction was claimed on a debatable and bona fide interpretation of the provision. The assessment order and the penalty order stand modified. The Commissioner of Income Tax's appeal against deletion of penalty is dismissed.
